title: 10 The Baby in the Crib · 婴儿床里的孩子

sents.t: A security camera records a child who's inside a crib when something downright creepy is captured.
sents.zh: 一台监控摄像头拍着婴儿床里的孩子，结果拍下了非常诡异的一幕。

sents.t: The child's mother had posted the following video, as she doesn't know what to make of it.
sents.zh: 孩子的妈妈发布了下面这段视频，因为她也不知道该怎么解释。

sents.t: She was in the same room as her son when, out of nowhere, he began to cry.
sents.zh: 她和儿子在同一个房间里，孩子突然毫无征兆地哭了起来。

sents.t: It wasn't until watching the footage that she was left disturbed.
sents.zh: 直到看了录像，她才感到不安。

sents.t: The mother writes, "I'm still trying to figure out if the camera glitched or something pushed my baby."
sents.zh: 妈妈写道：“我还在想，到底是摄像头卡了，还是有什么东西推了我的宝宝。”

sents.t: The child all of a sudden disappears from the camera's view.
sents.zh: 孩子突然从镜头里消失了。

sents.t: It appears that he was pushed over forcefully.
sents.zh: 看起来他是被用力推倒的。

sents.t: The question is, though, what exactly had pushed him over?
sents.zh: 但问题是，到底是什么推倒了他？

sents.t: The cradle in the back continues to swing as the child vanishes from the frame, suggesting that this wasn't a glitch.
sents.zh: 孩子从画面中消失时，后面的摇篮还在继续摆动，说明这不是画面卡顿。

sents.t: If it was, then the swing would have skipped a frame, just like the child had.
sents.zh: 如果是卡顿，摇篮也会像孩子一样跳掉一帧。

sents.t: But as you can see, not a single frame is skipped.
sents.zh: 但正如你看到的，一帧都没有跳。

sents.t: So then, if this wasn't a glitch, then what was it?
sents.zh: 那么，如果不是卡顿，那又是什么？

sents.t: No one else is seen in the room except the mother and child, and nothing appears to have pushed him over.
sents.zh: 房间里除了妈妈和孩子，没有别人，也看不到有什么东西推了他。

sents.t: As with all videos, it's up to you to decide if this is something paranormal or not.
sents.zh: 和所有视频一样，是不是灵异现象，由你来决定。

sents.t: The child's mother has yet to figure that out.
sents.zh: 孩子的妈妈到现在也没弄明白。

sents.t: But as always, feel free to share what you think.
sents.zh: 和往常一样，欢迎分享你的看法。
